basic_profile.bio: Hi! I'm a 29-year-old Pokémon enthusiast from Austin, Texas. I work as a freelance graphic designer and spend my free time playing Pokémon Go and exploring the latest tech gadgets. I'm relatively new to Reddit but love connecting with others who share my interests. My online hours typically range from 7 PM to 11 PM CST, especially during weekends. I'm currently single and enjoy mingling at local Pokémon Go meetups.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have an extensive background in graphic design, having graduated with a degree in Visual Communication. Over the years, I've honed my skills in digital art and am self-taught in the latest design software. My interest in Pokémon Go stems from a childhood love for the Pokémon series, and I've been following tech advancements closely since high school.
